definitions.explanation: The regions of the Earth between the tropics and the polar circles, characterized by moderate climates.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{温帯|おんたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}→位置：10013_ichi⟧して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Japan is located in the temperate zone.

examples.japanese: {温帯|おんたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{四季|しき}→四季：02000_shiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦はっきり→はっきり：01228_hakkiri⟧して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The temperate climate has distinct four seasons.

examples.japanese: {温帯|おんたい}⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な⟦{農作物|のうさくもつ}→農作物：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: Various crops grow in temperate regions.

notes:
{温帯|おんたい} is a geographical term for the temperate climate zones, located between the tropics and the polar regions.

WORD FORMATION:
⟦{温|おん}→温：02550_on⟧ (warm) + ⟦{帯|たい}→帯：03382_tai⟧ (zone, belt)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {温帯|おんたい}⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧: temperate climate
- {温帯|おんたい}⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧: temperate region
- {温帯|おんたい}⟦{林|りん}→林：noentry⟧: temperate forest
- {温帯|おんたい}⟦{低気圧|ていきあつ}→低気圧：21712_teikiatsu⟧: extratropical cyclone

CLIMATE ZONES:
- ⟦{熱帯|ねったい}→熱帯：03531_nettai⟧: tropical zone
- ⟦{亜熱帯|あねったい}→亜熱帯：23940_anettai⟧: subtropical zone
- {温帯|おんたい}: temperate zone
- ⟦{寒帯|かんたい}→寒帯：04124_kantai⟧: frigid/polar zone

Japan lies primarily in the {温帯|おんたい}, which is why it has four distinct seasons (⟦{四季|しき}→四季：02000_shiki⟧). This is a formal/academic term, commonly found in geography textbooks and weather reports.
